RECONSTRUCTED TEXT — Open Library search-inside, 2026-09-06
===========================================================
TWO QUEBEC OUTDOOR GUIDES, AND THE COLUMN ALIGNMENT THAT HAD TO BE SOLVED BEFORE EITHER COULD BE
USED. Both are p_430 group 4 items. Both were attempted earlier the same day and NOTHING WAS
RECORDED, because the OCR scrambles their columns in exactly the way the UPU postal dictionary's
were scrambled. This file records the controls that settled them.

NOT SCANS. Both books are lending-restricted; neither has been read. Text assembled from
overlapping twelve-word windows returned by https://openlibrary.org/search/inside.json (contract at
f_4933). Page images return HTTP 403.


===============================================================================
ITEM 1. LES PISTES DE SKI DE FOND AU QUÉBEC (1977)
        Internet Archive: lespistesdeskide0000veil — scan leaf 294
===============================================================================

RECOVERED RUN (a list of clubs with their mailing addresses):

    "... [Club] DuSablon | 190 est, rue Principale | Ste-Agathe-des-Monts ||
    Club Mont Plante | Casier postal 308 | Val David, Québec J0T 2N0 ||
    KANAWANA OUTING CLUB Y.M.C.A. | 882, Montmorency | CHÂTEAUGUAY, QUÉBEC J6J 1S5 ||
    McGill Outing Club | 3480, McTavish St. | Montréal ..."

THE ALIGNMENT IS STRAIGHT HERE, and three internal controls say so: **J0T 2N0** is Val-David's
postal code, **J6J 1S5** is Châteauguay's, and **3480 McTavish** is McGill's own student-union
address. Each of the three lands on the row the plain reading assigns it, so no offset applies to
this list.

WHY IT MATTERS. The Kanawana Outing Club's mailing address in 1977 is **not the camp and not 1441
Drummond**. It is a street address in Châteauguay — a private house or a club officer's home,
forty kilometres the other side of Montreal from Saint-Sauveur. This is the second independent
sighting of a Châteauguay connection: Lovell's Montreal City Directory for 1976 carried a second
Kanawana listing under Châteauguay with the telephone 692-2801, and 514-692 is the Châteauguay
exchange. So the club was administered from a private address in Châteauguay across at least
1976-77, by somebody whose name this project does not have and which a Châteauguay street directory
or voters' list for those years would give.

AND THE COMPANY IT KEPT. The list is one of ski clubs, and Kanawana's neighbours in it are Club
Mont Plante of Val-David and the **McGill Outing Club**. That is the register the club belonged to:
not a camp programme, a public cross-country ski club, which is exactly what Bonnie Buxton and Betty
Guernsey's *Montréal Inside Out* (1976) describes when it advertises "20 miles of blazed trails, a
clubhouse and babysitting" to the general Montreal public (f_4942).

The same leaf also carries "Huberdeau | Otter Lake Haus | Tél.: (819) 687-2767", which is a
different list in the same book and is noted only because 819-687 is the Huberdeau exchange and
therefore useful as a control below.


===============================================================================
ITEM 2. GUIDE PLEIN AIR QUÉBEC (1991)
        Internet Archive: guidepleinairque0000unse — scan leaf 200
===============================================================================

THE RAW WINDOW, which is what stopped the earlier attempt:

    "Sainl-Hippofyte Domaine des Prte 932.7161 Mont-Laurier Kanawana 819.623.5258 Saint-Sauveur 'Y'
    CountryCamp 849.5331 Huberdeau 737.6551 Laval"

Read straight — town, facility, telephone — that puts **Kanawana at Mont-Laurier** with an 819-623
number, and the 'Y' Country Camp at Saint-Sauveur with 849-5331. Both are wrong, and the earlier
attempt correctly recorded nothing.

THE CONTROLS, all three documented from inside the same corpus rather than from memory:

1. **849-5331 is the YMCA of Montreal, 1441 Drummond.** Bonnie Buxton and Betty Guernsey's Montreal
   guidebook prints the two Montreal Ys on one line: "*Drummond (849-5331) — YM-YWHA: 5500,
   Westbury (737-6551)*" (item montreallenvouta0000mccr, leaf 214). Every camp directory this
   project holds from 1975 to 2001 gives 849-5331 for Kanawana.
2. **737-6551 is the YM-YWHA of Montreal, 5500 Westbury** — same line, and confirmed again in
   several Jewish community directories in the corpus.
3. **The 'Y' Country Camp is the YM-YWHA's camp and it is at Huberdeau.** The *Directory of
   Canadian Welfare Services / Repertoire des services sociaux canadiens* (Ottawa: Canadian
   Council on Social Development, 1974), item directoryofcanad1974unse, leaf 218: "**'Y' Country
   Camp Branch, 5500 Westbury Avenue, Montreal (winter), Huberdeau, Quebec (summer)**".
   [CORRECTED 2026-09-06, same day: this file first called that item a "Directory of Canadian
   [Camps] 1974", read off its identifier without checking its metadata. It is a directory of
   WELFARE SERVICES, published by the Canadian Council on Social Development -- which is why a
   YM-YWHA branch camp is in it, and which makes it a different and in some ways better witness
   than a camping-association directory would be. The control it provides is unaffected.]
   Corroborated by
   jewishfamilybook00stra and jewishcatalogdo00sieg, both "Y Country Camp (Huberdeau), c/o YM/YWHA
   of Montreal, 5500 Westbury", and by isbn_9783319461212, "Bronfman Y Country Camp (YM-YWHA Jewish
   Community Centres of Montreal), 130 Chemin Lac Blanc, Huberdeau, QC".
4. **819-623 is the Mont-Laurier exchange**, which the same leaf's other lists corroborate (819-687
   for Huberdeau, 819-587 for Ferme-Neuve).

THE ALIGNMENT THAT SATISFIES ALL FOUR. The facility column runs one row ahead of the town and
telephone columns in the OCR stream. The rows are:

    Mont-Laurier    | Domaine des Prêtres   | 819-623-5258
    SAINT-SAUVEUR   | KANAWANA              | 849-5331
    Huberdeau       | 'Y' Country Camp      | 737-6551

Each row is now independently anchored: a Mont-Laurier number on a Mont-Laurier property, the
YMCA's own number on the YMCA's camp, the YM-YWHA's own number on the YM-YWHA's camp at the town
the 1974 directory gives for it. The straight reading fails all three at once; this one passes all
three.

WHAT IS RECORDED FROM IT: that Kanawana appears in a 1991 Quebec outdoor guide, at Saint-Sauveur,
under the YMCA's Montreal number, among the province's outdoor and camp centres. That is a modest
finding, and the alignment work is most of its value — the same offset will apply to the rest of
this list, and to anyone who comes back for the other camps on it.

WHAT IS NOT RECORDED: the trailing "Huberdeau 737.6551 Laval" tail, where the interleave breaks
down at the window's edge; and the row before Mont-Laurier, whose facility name is not in the
window (Saint-Hippolyte and 932-7161 belong to it).

QUERIES RUN, in order:
  "Mont-Laurier Kanawana"  ·  "Kanawana" "Huberdeau"  ·  "Country Camp" "Huberdeau"  ·  "737-6551"
  ·  "Kanawana Outing Club Y.M.C.A." (0 hits — the OCR breaks it) · "Casier postal 308 Val David"  ·
  "Québec JOT 2N0 Kanawana Outing Club"  ·  "Outing Club Y.M.C.A. 882, Montmorency Châteauguay"
  (0 hits) · "882, Montmorency Châteauguay"  ·  "Kanawana Outing Club"  ·
  "Ste-Agathe-des-Monts Club Mont Plante"  ·  "Châteauguay, Québec J6J 1S5 McGill Outing Club"

A NOTE FOR THE NEXT PERSON. This is the fourth time a column ambiguity in this project has been
settled by finding a field whose value can only land one way — after Kanawyer in the UPU postal
list, Lac Bâtiment in the Matawinie lake cluster, and D-U-N-S 20-765-0813 in the credit
directories. The method is now explicit: **do not read across a scrambled row. Find the field whose
value is unique in the corpus, query that field on its own, and let it tell you which row it is
in.** Here it took three of them, because one would have been a coincidence.
